extDesc.message: Set up automatic tab refresh with intervals from 30 seconds: custom intervals, force refresh, multiple tabs with countdown, right-click menus, and a keyboard shortcut.

commandToggleRefresh.message: Toggle auto refresh for the current tab

notifStopped.message: An auto refresh task was cancelled (the tab was closed or the page is restricted)

notifSessionLost.message: The login session for $SITE$ has expired. Backup for this site is paused to avoid overwriting good state; please sign in again

btnStart.message: Start auto refresh for this tab

discardedHint.message: - tab sleeping, refresh skipped (wake the tab to resume)

errTabGone.message: Cannot access this tab; reload the page and try again

msgStopped.message: Auto refresh stopped for this tab

msgClamped.message: Minimum custom interval is 30 seconds; set to 30 seconds

restrictHint.message: Browser internal pages (chrome:// etc.) cannot be auto-refreshed

errRestricted.message: Browser internal pages (chrome:// etc.) cannot be auto-refreshed

cookieBackupHint.message: Backs up this site's cookies locally and restores the login after a browser restart. Cookies are stored unencrypted in plaintext - assess the risk yourself

keepAliveHint.message: Periodically injects simulated mouse/keyboard activity into the monitored page to delay server-side login expiry timed by user interaction

httpHeartbeatHint.message: Sends a background request with cookies to the monitored URL every 4 minutes; holds sessions timed by the last request without reloading the page

keepWatchingHint.message: Default: the task stops on a hit. On: keep monitoring and notify only for newly appeared keywords

skipOnActivityHint.message: Skips this refresh if there was real user input within 60 seconds; keep-alive simulation is not mistaken for a human

keepAwakeHint.message: Holds a power lock and keeps the system awake while tasks run - be careful on laptop battery

webhookHint.message: Works with Discord / Telegram / Slack / Ntfy and custom endpoints; sent as POST JSON

notifKeywordHits.message: The monitored page now contains the keyword "$KW$"

notifTaskPausedError.message: The monitored page keeps returning errors (5xx/404); the task is auto-paused and will resume once the page recovers

notifTaskPausedCaptcha.message: The monitored page hit a bot verification wall; the task is auto-paused - pass the check and press Resume

skipDiscardedHint.message: Skips this refresh when the tab has been discarded (unloaded) by the browser; it resumes once the tab is woken

emptyHint.message: No tasks yet: click "Start auto refresh" on any tab.
